explanation: I used `WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment()` to parse the input as a body fragment, then walked tokens with `next_token()`. For each ordinary `#text` token, I checked the decoded text from `get_modifiable_text()` and wrapped the token’s normalized serialization from `serialize_token()` in `<mark>` when it contained the keyword; all other tokens were serialized unchanged, which preserves normalized HTML output and avoids wrapping special-element text like `script`, `style`, `title`, and `textarea` because those are not `#text` tokens.
